about_title: Grant Road, Mumbai - Historic South Mumbai Neighbourhood
about: Grant Road is one of South Mumbai's oldest and most layered localities - a dense, vibrant mix of heritage buildings, bustling markets, old Parsi and Maharashtrian families, and a thriving working-class community. Flanked by Tardeo to the north and Charni Road to the south, it sits at the heart of the city's original urban fabric. character_vibe_description: Character & Vibe An honest snapshot - the energy, the people, the pace. The kind of thing no other directory tells you. Grant Road is old Bombay in its truest form. It doesn't try to be anything it isn't. The mornings smell of fresh bread from Irani bakeries, the afternoons hum with the noise of Agripada's markets, and the evenings belong to families on their building staircases and old men at Parsi cafés nursing their third chai. Tardeo is the quiet, moneyed counterpart - heritage bungalows, old Parsi families and the occasional luxury tower. Gamdevi is literary and artistic. Agripada is loud, warm and deeply communal. Together they make Grant Road one of Mumbai's most genuinely layered neighbourhoods - not gentrified, not forgotten, just real.

faq.question: What is Grant Road known for?
faq.answer: Grant Road is known for its historic red-light district (Kamathipura), the iconic Grant Road railway station on the Western Line, proximity to Tardeo and Gamdevi, and being one of South Mumbai's most densely populated and culturally layered neighbourhoods.

faq.question: What is the pin code of Grant Road?
faq.answer: Grant Road has multiple pin codes: 400007 (Grant Road / Tardeo) and 400008 (Agripada / Bhuleshwar).

faq.question: What are the sub-areas within Grant Road?
faq.answer: The main micro-localities within Grant Road are Tardeo, Agripada, Gamdevi, Bhuleshwar, Charni Road, Kamathipura, Nana Chowk, and August Kranti Marg.

faq.question: What is the property price in Grant Road?
faq.answer: Property prices in Grant Road range from ₹80 lakh for a 1BHK in Agripada to ₹1.8–2.8 Cr for a 2BHK in Tardeo/Gamdevi, and ₹2.5–4 Cr in premium Tardeo high-rises. Rental rates range from ₹18,000 to ₹75,000 per month depending on the sub-area and flat size (as of May 2026).

faq.question: How to commute from Grant Road?
faq.answer: Grant Road is served by Western Railway's Grant Road Station (10 min to Churchgate), BEST bus routes 1, 2, 3, 21, 83, 124, and direct access to the Eastern and Western Express Highways via Tardeo Road. The area is also well-served by auto rickshaws and taxis.

faq.question: Which hospitals are in Grant Road?
faq.answer: Major hospitals in and near Grant Road include Jaslok Hospital, Breach Candy Hospital, Nair Hospital (BYL Nair), Cama & Albless Hospital, and Wockhardt Hospital.

faq.question: Which schools are in Grant Road?
faq.answer: Notable schools in Grant Road include St. Xavier's High School, Bharda New High School, Anjuman-I-Islam School, Balmohan Vidyamandir, and Cathedral & John Connon School (nearby).
